integrity: The proof is symbolic and uniform in the prime power \(q\). The standalone verifier uses exact arithmetic at \(q=25\) to check the Frobenius orbit and reciprocal-sum identity, exhaustively verifies the finite-difference bijections in all four relevant degrees, and reconstructs the \(n=3\) coefficient vector. These finite checks are corroborative, not a substitute for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the degree-p factors of \(U^q-U-a\) and magic indices \(q^n-1\); it does not classify all counterexamples over \(\mathbb F_q[T]\), treat nonzero leading magic digit, or optimize degree for fixed characteristic.
title: Prime-power Artin–Schreier counterexamples to Goss’s magic-index bound
